Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme and let <MATH_0002>
be a geometric point of <MATH_0003>. By definition this means that <MATH_0004>
is algebraically closed. In particular the absolute Galois group of <MATH_0005>
is trivial. Hence by
Theorem <REF_0001>
the category of sheaves on <MATH_0006> is equivalent
to the category of sets. The equivalence is given by taking
sections over <MATH_0007>. This finally provides us with an
alternative definition of the stalk functor. Namely, the functor
<MATH_0008>
is isomorphic to the functor
<MATH_0009>
To prove this rigorously one can use
Lemma <REF_0002> part (3)
with <MATH_0010>. Moreover, having said this the general case of
Lemma <REF_0003> part (3)
follows from functoriality of pullbacks.
